title: HAXcms site skeleton
description: A reusable starter for new HAXcms sites, served by the `skeletonsList` / `getSkeleton` endpoints and written by the HAXcms site-skeleton-generator. `build.items` is an extended JSON Outline Schema item list: same tree fields, no `location`, plus an inline `content` HTML string.

meta.description: Describes the skeleton itself and how it appears in selection UIs.

name.description: Skeleton name. `skeletonsList` reports the normalized FILE name as `machineName`; `getSkeleton` matches the requested name against the file name, `meta.machineName` or `meta.name`. Keeping all three identical avoids surprises.

machineName.description: Same as `name`; written by newer generators.

priority.description: Sort weight in selection lists (lower sorts first).

sourceUrl.description: URL / path of the site this skeleton was generated from.

useCaseTitle.description: Human readable title shown in selectors.

site.description: Initial HAXcms site configuration for the generated site.

theme.description: Theme element tag to apply, for example `clean-one`.

settings.description: Copied into `metadata.site.settings` of the new site.

platform.description: Copied into `metadata.platform` of the new site.

plugins.description: Plugins to enable on a site created from this skeleton. A starting point only: later changes to the skeleton do not affect sites already made from it. See the HAXcms plugin specification, https://github.com/haxtheweb/haxcms-plugin-examples/pull/1.

files.description: Files to copy into the new site's `files/` directory. Generators write `{ "path": "..." }` objects; bare strings are accepted.

theme.description: Theme metadata for dashboards. Older skeletons hold tile visuals (`hexCode`, `cssVariable`, `icon`, `image`); generated skeletons merge in theme config (`element`, `path`, `name`, `thumbnail`, `regions`, ...). Both shapes are valid.

_skeleton.description: Optional generator metadata. Currently `fullThemeConfig` (`{ element, variables }`); older docs also described `originalMetadata` / `originalSettings`.

skeletonItem.description: Outline item plus inline initial content. ids only need to be unique within the skeleton; HAXcms issues fresh ids when it builds a site from it.
